environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: `:55` fails 400 whenever the request carries `transfer-encoding`, and `:58` fails the same for a bare `Content-Length`, so no request body is ever consumed and no upstream body byte is ever emitted; chunk state on this build is response-side only. Three shapes tried, all 400 with zero upstream requests. This is the clean per-build contrast that makes the other five decoders' behaviour attributable to the decoder rather than to the proxy as a class.
findings.title: Every request `Transfer-Encoding` is a 400, so this build never decodes a chunked request body at all

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
